purpose: Environment and classifier-resolution record for the canonical 2026-09-13 lower-side runs. Sibling record: it describes server 111 and leaves every hash-cited ledger and every existing execution_environment dict untouched.

host.cwd_note: cwd is the working directory of the DESCRIBED canonical 2026-09-13 run, read from the source.cwd field of the canonical ledgers q1_eps_lo_symbol_map.json and q1_lower_side_full_n.json (both record /root/eibo). The probe process itself was launched from /root; this record describes the run, not the probe's own launch directory. Corrected 2026-09-20 by Director after the two fields were found to disagree.

classifier.resolved_solver_note: sklearn's default solver; not a pinned choice.
classifier.penalty_attribute_note: The sentinel as stored on the estimator. The resolution block in linear_model/_logistic.py assigns to a local variable and never writes back to self.penalty, so the attribute legitimately retains the sentinel after fit.
classifier.effective_penalty_evidence: Coefficient equivalence: LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=0) and LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=0, penalty='l2') fitted on the same toy array produce bit-identical coefficients (max abs diff = 0.0); the sentinel fit also matches an explicit l1_ratio=0.0 fit to 0.0.
classifier.deprecation_warnings_note: The bare sentinel emits no warning; passing penalty='l2' explicitly is what emits the FutureWarning. Hence an empty warning list is the expected reading and is not evidence of an unrun fit.

cross_version_note: Resolution is identical across the two installed sklearn versions: both 1.9.0 (server 111) and 1.9.1 (platform-local container) resolve the sentinel to l2 with l1_ratio 0.0, and both use the default solver lbfgs, emitting no warning. No solver or penalty mechanism is asserted here to explain any cross-generation divergence in the ledgers; the cause of that divergence is unexplained and is deliberately not characterised.

pointers.local_container_dicts: The execution_environment dicts in artifacts/_project/intermediate/t1_lower_side_M1.json, t1_lower_side_M2.json, t1b_lower_side_k10.json and t1b_lower_side_k5.json describe the platform-local container (sklearn 1.9.1) by design. They are true statements about a different machine and must not be overwritten with the values in this record.
